rca_of_issue: Bug fix VERIFIED. Previous iteration used a 'REFERENCE MIRROR' that still generated Blue/Green/Yellow/Red locally when the upstream was unavailable — violating the AFEtm spec §14 rule that classification MUST come only from the authoritative engine. Current implementation removes calc_assessment entirely, replaces it with calc_math_only (documented math only), and marks any assessment created without upstream connectivity as calc_source='pending' with a null zone/pattern/action and a Spanish user-facing notice. All frontend surfaces (detail, home, history, compare) handle the null-zone case with distinct 'Pendiente' UI. No regressions in profile/delete/list endpoints.
